page.overview:
Who is Animal Refuge owner?

The Animal Refuge owner is the man in charge of the Springfield Animal Refuge. He offers to give Stampy a life that closely replicates the wild, but Homer Simpson is reluctant to follow through since there are other less moral options like ivory dealing that would be more lucrative.

At Lisa's wishes, Homer decides to give in. Stampy appears happy at the animal reserve, though he treats other elephants aggressively. The Animal Refuge owner explains that elephants, like people, can be jerks, just as Homer starts headbutting him repeatedly.
